description: Dr Jason Arday is an Associate Professor in Sociology at Durham University and will soon take up a professorship at Glasgow University. His research intersects across education, social mobility, mental health and race. Jason is a Trustee of the Runnymede Trust, the UK’s leading race equality think tank and was one of the authors of the 2019 Leading Routes report The Broken Pipeline.
